description_en: You can call the ModifyReplicationJobAttribute operation to modify the information of a migration task
description_zh: 调用ModifyReplicationJobAttribute修改迁移任务信息
name: ModifyReplicationJobAttribute

parameters.help_en: The ID of the migration task
parameters.help_zh: 迁移任务ID
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the migration task. The name must meet the following requirements:

The name must be unique.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
迁移任务名称。迁移任务的名称需满足以下要求：

任务名称必须唯一。
长度为2~128个英文或中文字符，必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头，可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the migration task.

The description must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
迁移任务描述。

长度应为2~128个英文或中文字符，必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头，可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The type of the migration destination. This parameter can be modified only before the migration task starts. Valid values:

Image: After the migration is complete, SMC generates an Alibaba Cloud image from the source server. You can use this image to create an ECS instance.

ContainerImage: After the migration is complete, SMC generates a container image from the source server. You can use this image in Container Registry.

TargetInstance: After the migration is complete, SMC migrates the source to a destination instance. If you set this parameter to this value, you must also specify the `InstanceId` parameter.

The value of this parameter is not case-sensitive.

Migrating servers that run Windows or an Arm-based operating system to container images is not supported
parameters.help_zh:
迁移交付的目标类型。仅支持在迁移任务启动前修改。取值范围：
Image：迁移成功后，SMC为您的源服务器生成阿里云镜像，您可使用该镜像创建ECS实例达到迁移至阿里云的目的。
ContainerImage：迁移成功后，SMC为您的源服务器生成容器镜像，您可以在容器镜像服务中使用该镜像。

TargetInstance：迁移成功后，SMC将您的迁移源直接迁移至目标实例。当您设置该参数值时，您需要同时指定`InstanceId`参数。

该参数的取值不区分大小写。
Windows操作系统和Arm架构操作系统不支持迁移至容器镜像
parameters.name: target_type

parameters.help_en:
The time when you want to start the migration task. SMC automatically starts the migration task at the specified time.

The time must follow the ISO 8601 standard and be in UTC. The format is YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ. For example, 2018-01-01T12:00:00Z specifies 20:00:00 on January 1, 2018 (UTC+8).

If you leave this parameter empty, SMC does not automatically start the migration task. You must call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/121823.html operation to start the task
parameters.help_zh:
设置迁移任务的执行时间。SMC在指定时间自动为您启动迁移任务。

执行时间遵循ISO8601标准，并需要使用UTC时间，格式为YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ。例如，2018-01-01T12:00:00Z，表示北京时间2018年01月01日20点00分00秒。

当执行时间为空时，SMC不自动启动迁移任务，您需要调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/121823.html启动
parameters.name: scheduled_start_time

parameters.help_en:
The name of the destination image. The name must meet the following requirements:

The image name must be unique in the same Alibaba Cloud region.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

If an image with the same name already exists in the current region when the migration task is running, the system adds the migration task ID (JobId) to the end of the image name as a suffix. Example: ImageName-JobId
parameters.help_zh:
迁移任务交付的目标镜像名称。目标镜像的名称需满足以下要求：

同一阿里云地域下，镜像名称必须唯一。
长度为2~128个英文或中文字符，必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头，可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）。

如果迁移任务运行过程中，当前地域已经存在相同名称的镜像，则系统默认在镜像名称后面添加迁移任务ID（JobId）作为后缀，如：ImageName-JobId
parameters.name: image_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the destination instance
parameters.help_zh: 目标实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The system disk size of the destination ECS instance. Unit: GiB. Valid values: 20 to 500.

The value of this parameter must be greater than the space that is used by the system disk of the source server. For example, if the system disk of the source server is 500 GiB in size and 100 GiB of the space is used, you must set this parameter to a value greater than 100
parameters.help_zh:
目标阿里云服务器ECS的系统盘大小，单位：GiB。取值范围为20~500。

参数取值需要大于源服务器系统盘实际占用大小，例如，源系统盘大小为500 GiB，实际占用100 GiB，则该参数取值需大于100 GiB
parameters.name: system_disk_size

parameters.help_en:
The interval at which an incremental migration task runs. Unit: hours. Valid values: 1 to 168.

This parameter is required if the `RunOnce` parameter is set to false
parameters.help_zh:
增量迁移任务运行的时间间隔，单位：小时。取值范围为1~168。

`RunOnce`参数值为false时，该参数为必填参数
parameters.name: frequency

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of images to retain for an incremental migration task. Valid values: 1 to 10.

This parameter is required if the `RunOnce` parameter is set to false
parameters.help_zh:
增量迁移任务默认保留的最大镜像数。取值范围为1~10。

`RunOnce`参数值为false时，该参数为必填参数
parameters.name: max_number_of_image_to_keep

parameters.help_en:
The instance type of the intermediate instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25620.html operation to query the instance types provided by ECS.

If you specify this parameter, the system creates an intermediate instance of this instance type. If the specified instance type is out of stock, the migration task fails to be created.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system selects an instance type in a specific order to create the intermediate instance. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/121707.html
parameters.help_zh:
中转实例的实例规格。

调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25620.html可查询云服务器ECS提供的实例规格。

指定该参数后，系统会选择该实例规格创建中转实例。若该实例规格库存不足，则迁移任务创建失败。
不指定该参数时，系统会默认按照一定顺序选择实例规格来创建中转实例，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/121707.html
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the launch template
parameters.help_zh: 实例启动模板ID
parameters.name: launch_template_id

parameters.help_en: The version of the launch template
parameters.help_zh: 实例启动模板的版本
parameters.name: launch_template_version

parameters.help_en: The name of the RAM role for the instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例RAM角色名称
parameters.name: instance_ram_role

parameters.help_en: The namespace of the Docker container. For more information about Docker container images, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/60744.html
parameters.help_zh: Docker的命名空间。关于Docker容器镜像详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/60744.html
parameters.name: container_namespace

parameters.help_en: The image repository for the Docker container. For more information about Docker container images, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/60744.html
parameters.help_zh: Docker的镜像仓库。关于Docker容器镜像详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/60744.html
parameters.name: container_repository

parameters.help_en: The image tag for the Docker container. For more information about Docker container images, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/60744.html
parameters.help_zh: Docker的镜像标签。关于Docker容器镜像详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/60744.html
parameters.name: container_tag

parameters.help_en:
The expiration time of the migration task. The value can be a time that is 7 to 90 days later than the time when the migration task is created.

You can modify the expiration time only when the migration task is in the Ready, Running, Stopped, InError, or Waiting state.

The time must follow the ISO 8601 standard and be in UTC. The format is `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`. For example, 2018-01-01T12:00:00Z specifies 20:00:00 on January 1, 2018 (UTC+8).

If you leave this parameter empty, the task does not expire.

After a task expires, it is marked as Expired. The task is retained for 7 days. After 7 days, the system automatically deletes the task.

Default value: 30 days after the migration task is created. This means that the migration task is valid for 30 days by default
parameters.help_zh:
迁移任务的过期时间。取值范围：迁移任务创建时间+7天~迁移任务创建时间+90天

过期时间只允许迁移任务在Ready（未开始）、Running（运行中）、Stopped（已暂停）、InError（出错）或Waiting（等待中）状态下修改。
过期时间须遵循ISO8601标准，并需要使用UTC+0时间，格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`。例如，2018-01-01T12:00:00Z，表示北京时间2018年01月01日20点00分00秒。
过期时间设置为空，表示任务无限期有效。
任务到期后会被标记为过期状态，保存7天，7天后系统会自动清理。

默认值：迁移任务创建时间+30天（表示迁移任务的默认有效期为创建后30天）
parameters.name: valid_time

true

目标系统盘分区N是否开启块复制。取值范围：

The size of partition N of the destination system disk. Unit: bytes. The default value is the size of the source system disk partition.

The size of a partition cannot exceed the size of the system disk. The total size of all partitions in a system disk cannot exceed the size of the system disk

The sequence number of the data disk on the destination ECS instance. Valid values: 1 to 16.

The initial value is 1.

You can create a destination data disk only for a data disk that exists on the source server
fields.help_zh:
目标阿里云服务器ECS的数据盘顺序。取值范围为1~16。

初始值为1。

您只能为源服务器中存在的数据盘创建目标数据盘
fields.name: index

Specifies whether to enable block replication for partition N of data disk N. Valid values:

true

false
fields.help_zh:
目标数据盘N分区N是否开启块复制。取值范围：
true。
false
fields.name: block

fields.help_en:
The device ID of partition N of data disk N.

For the value of N, see the device ID of the source partition
fields.help_zh:
目标数据盘N分区N对应的分区设备标识。
N的实际取值请参考迁移源的分区设备标识
fields.name: device

fields.help_en:
The size of partition N of data disk N. Unit: bytes. The default value is the size of the source data disk partition.

The size of a partition cannot exceed the size of the data disk. The total size of all partitions in a data disk cannot exceed the size of the data disk
fields.help_zh:
目标数据盘N分区N的大小。单位：Byte。默认为源数据盘分区大小。
分区空间大小不能超过数据盘空间大小，并且在同一数据盘下所有分区空间大小之和不能超过数据盘空间大小
fields.name: size_bytes

fields.help_en:
The size of the data disk on the destination ECS instance. Unit: GiB. Valid values: 20 to 32768.

The value of this parameter must be greater than the space that is used by the data disk of the source server. For example, if the data disk of the source server is 500 GiB in size and 100 GiB of the space is used, you must set this parameter to a value greater than 100
fields.help_zh:
目标阿里云服务器ECS的数据盘大小，单位：GiB。取值范围为20~32768。

参数取值需要大于源服务器数据盘实际占用大小。例如，源数据盘大小为500 GiB，实际占用100 GiB，则该参数取值需大于100 GiB
fields.name: size

parameters.help_en:
The network mode for data transmission. Valid values:

0: Internet transfer mode. The source server must be able to access the Internet. Data is transferred over the Internet.

2: internal network transfer mode. If you select this mode, you must set the VSwitchId parameter. The VpcId parameter is not required because the service can automatically query the VPC ID
parameters.help_zh:
数据传输网络模式。取值范围：

0：表示公网传输模式。此时要求您的源服务器能够访问公网，迁云数据从公网传输。
2：表示内网传输模式，选用此模式必须设置VSwitchId参数（VpcId参数可以不设置，服务内部可以通过接口反查出来）
parameters.name: net_mode

parameters.help_zh: 已配置高速通道服务或者VPN网关的VPC ID
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The parameters of the replication driver. The parameters are key-value pairs in the JSON format. The keys are fixed. The value can be up to 2,048 characters in length.

The replication driver is a tool that is used to replicate data from the source server to the intermediate instance. The parameters supported by replication drivers may vary. The SMT replication driver supports the following parameters:

bandwidth_limit: the bandwidth limit for data transmission.

compress_level: the compression ratio of data to be transferred.

checksum: specifies whether to enable checksum verification.

For information about the value of the replication driver, see the `SourceServers.ReplicationDriver` parameter in the response of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2402126.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
复制驱动器的参数信息。参数信息为JSON格式键值对，键值固定。最大长度：2048个字符。

复制驱动器是指，复制源服务器数据到中转实例时所使用的工具。不同复制驱动器支持参数可能不同。复制驱动器SMT目前支持以下参数：

bandwidth_limit：传输速度带宽限制。
compress_level：传输压缩率。
checksum：是否开启checksum校验。

复制驱动器的取值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2402126.html的返回参数0
parameters.name: replication_parameters
